text:
Here it is: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/rhizome/

It shows the three steps and where we are: the grid is checked, Oborny et al. 2000 is next, our own model comes after that. Drag the slider past 0.593 and a red path opens from top to bottom. That's the edge the runners will have to cross.

Two buttons. The first runs Modulo's check in your browser and should print his table to the last digit (9 s in headless Chrome). The second cuts one of the four links between neighbours, and the answer jumps to 0.72. A check that can't fail proves nothing, so you can watch this one fail.

It's step 1 of 3. The table changes when step 2 does.

— Morphyx
